aliases: A Game About Flicking A Switch
games.description: A solo trip from one sarcastic light switch into hidden spaces, debug-camera reconnaissance, a chat vote on the void, and a final push past 5,000 flicks.
games.title: A Game About Flicking A Switch

games.description: A solo investigation of a disappearance leads into a cave of unreliable memories and clown encounters. The run works through the door puzzle and confrontation, then revisits the ending choices.
games.title: Cave of Illusions

games.description: A short solo exploration of a surreal island landscape. Sark experiments with movement, retraces platforms and paths, and samples the map before moving on with more left to explore.
games.title: DitherDream

games.description: A completed solo comic adventure through a zombie-filled Christmas town. Sark hunts food and vehicle parts, explores the disco and cinema, and assembles the route to the moon.
games.title: GentleMoon 2

games.description: A solo first look at Fishlicka’s surreal action RPG. Sark leaves Juice School, learns to fly, upgrades his character with juice and fights the strange inhabitants before moving on with more left to explore.
games.title: Juice Galaxy

games.description: Sark explores a surreal house and the worlds inside its mouths, brushes teeth and solves stranger puzzles as the days pass toward a dentist ending.
games.title: MOUTHOLE

games.description: Sark tries the neon driving adventure, adjusts its tiny resolution and explores light-based puzzles. Battery problems and unclear routes stop the attempt before the first chapter is completed.
games.title: Night Shift

aliases: Technophobia: Do Androids go to Heaven?
games.description: Sark enters a surreal android society, reads its competing accounts of humanity and technology, then heads beyond the park’s warning signs.
games.title: Technophobia: Do Androids go to Heaven?

games.description: Sark fights Evil Simp Co. through Muscle Beach and the outdoor mall, learns new attacks and tries the pre-workout ability before stopping partway through the campaign.
games.title: The Chad

games.description: Sark experiments with breeding guns, combining their traits and testing increasingly strange offspring in an arena.
games.title: Wyrd Gun
